feed.title: Tokenization Systems: comment letters
feed.subtitle: Federal comment letters and international standard-setter responses, newest first. 121 recommendations across twenty-two federal letters.

entry.title: Treasury GENIUS Act section 3 issuance, offer and sale comment
entry.summary: Of the two facts proposed Sec. 1523.3(c) turns on, a foreign issuer's technological capability to comply with a lawful order is readable from its deployed contract and on-chain history, while whether it will comply is not observable at all; the rule should name the observable check as a floor. Filed October 13, 2026 on TREAS-DO-2026-0496; 7 recommendations; comment period open.

entry.title: FDIC AG30 disclosure of information comment
entry.summary: Supervisory material reaches the public by exception; a standing, safeguarded channel for aggregated analysis would let the supervisory process be examined before a failure, not after. Filed October 5, 2026 on RIN 3064-AG30; 4 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: CFTC 3038-0076 clearing organization requirements comment
entry.summary: Clearing organizations must now show, instrument by instrument, that a tokenized asset conveys the traditional asset's rights, yet the Commission's collection captures that determination in no defined form. Filed October 5, 2026 on CFTC-2026-1685; 4 recommendations; omb review pending.

entry.title: Federal Reserve R-1835 AML and CFT programs comment
entry.summary: Four agencies are writing one anti-money-laundering program rule four times, and the only substantive divergence in the Board's version is the coordination mechanism itself. Filed September 21, 2026 on Docket No. R-1835; 9 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FDIC AG27 assessments comment
entry.summary: The cohort the assessment rule reclassifies carries measurably higher run risk than the cohort it is priced against; the framework prices size and resolvability, not novel-activity exposure. Filed August 24, 2026 on RIN 3064-AG27; 4 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FDIC AG21 resolution submissions comment
entry.summary: The rule narrows what covered institutions must submit for resolution planning, and the content it removes is disproportionately the content that predicts a run. Filed August 24, 2026 on RIN 3064-AG21; 6 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FinCEN AB74 PPSI customer identification program comment

category.label: FinCEN (joint with OCC, Board, FDIC, NCUA)

entry.summary: The account definition does two jobs in the GENIUS Act framework; the proposal codifies one and disclaims the other in a footnote that belongs in binding regulatory text. Filed August 21, 2026 on FINCEN-2026-0101; 8 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: OCC AF55 PPSI BSA and sanctions comment
entry.summary: Supervising a PPSI AML and sanctions program works only when the OCC and FinCEN read the same measured control posture of one operator, and the OCC and FDIC rules align. Filed July 23, 2026 on OCC-2026-0463; 8 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: SEC DSP-3 Draft Strategic Plan comment
entry.summary: Where the plan's digital-asset objectives turn on whether a system is decentralized, decentralization must be measured against a reproducible standard the plan does not yet name. Filed July 2, 2026 on File Number DSP-3; 4 recommendations; final plan pending.

entry.title: FSB AI Sound Practices response (first international standard-setter filing)
entry.summary: All seven consultation questions answered, anchored by the first control-layer measurement of live agentic payments: autonomous agents already executing irreversible payments through a settlement layer no institution governs. Filed July 1, 2026 on Consultation report of June 10, 2026; international response; final report pending.

entry.title: FDIC AG29 PPSI BSA and sanctions comment
entry.summary: The FDIC's supervision-and-coordination layer over a PPSI AML and sanctions program works only when the FDIC and FinCEN read the same measured control posture of one operator. Filed June 30, 2026 on RIN 3064-AG29; 6 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: NCUA GENIUS supplemental comment (routing table and suggested rule text)
entry.summary: A same-day supplement to the NCUA comment: a routing table keyed to the questions, a cross-agency alignment map, and suggested rule text for the five priority asks. Filed June 22, 2026 on NCUA-2026-1024; supplements No. 11; final rule pending.

entry.title: NCUA GENIUS stablecoin comment (completes GENIUS-agency coverage)
entry.summary: Stablecoin issuance standards for NCUA-licensed credit unions, the credit-union analogue of the OCC rule. Completes coverage of every GENIUS-implementing agency. Filed June 22, 2026 on NCUA-2026-1024; 11 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FinCEN-OFAC PPSI sanctions supplemental comment (reserve-concentration causal evidence)
entry.summary: A deadline-day supplement strengthening Recommendation 6: PPSI risk assessments must address reserve-custody concentration. Filed June 9, 2026 on FINCEN-2026-0100; supplements No. 6; final rule pending.

entry.title: FinCEN AML/CFT supplemental comment (effective-control evidence)
entry.summary: A deadline-day supplement strengthening Recommendation 4: the United States based AML/CFT officer should hold effective supervisory control, not a nominal title. Filed June 9, 2026 on FINCEN-2026-0034; supplements No. 5; final rule pending.

entry.title: FDIC AG19 PPSI activities comment
entry.summary: Recommendation 7 proposes an MVEP-gated conditional deposit insurance pass-through replacing §330.11(a)(3)'s categorical foreclosure, attaching to the reserve deposit at the IDI rather than the stablecoin. Filed April 20, 2026 on RIN 3064-AG19; 12 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Banking agencies joint AML/CFT comment (91 FR 18304)
entry.summary: Banks increasingly perform control-layer functions in tokenized finance: PPSI reserve custody, tokenized deposit issuance, tokenized securities custody, Federal qualified PPSI operation, and correspondent services to issuers. Filed April 18, 2026 on 91 Fed. Reg. 18304; 7 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FinCEN-OFAC PPSI sanctions comment (FINCEN-2026-0100)
entry.summary: The joint NPRM operationalizes the first statutory control-layer mandate in U.S. financial regulation: the GENIUS Act block, freeze and reject capability across primary and secondary markets. Filed April 18, 2026 on FINCEN-2026-0100; 10 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FinCEN AML/CFT NPRM comment (FINCEN-2026-0034)
entry.summary: AML regulation has always been control-layer regulation: the Bank Secrecy Act attaches obligations to intermediaries, not to transactions or instruments. Filed April 18, 2026 on FINCEN-2026-0034; 7 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: FDIC AG20 PPSI application-rule comment
entry.summary: The AG20 application is the FDIC's first chance to map a prospective PPSI's control-layer topology, shaping both the approval decision and the baseline for ongoing supervision. Filed April 18, 2026 on RIN 3064-AG20; 4 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: Treasury GENIUS Act state-similarity comment
entry.summary: Treasury must judge fifty state frameworks substantially similar to the federal GENIUS Act framework; the proposed principles reduce this to section-by-section comparison against statutory text. Filed April 15, 2026 on TREAS-DO-2026-0232; 6 recommendations; final rule pending.

entry.title: OCC PPSI supplemental comment (control-layer extension)
entry.summary: A user transacting in a PPSI-issued stablecoin through an SEC-CUIP-covered interface receives none of the twelve interface-conduct conditions; the protection gradient is inverted. Filed April 13, 2026 on OCC-2025-0372-0069; 1 recommendation; final rule pending.

entry.title: OCC PPSI MVEP comment (RIN 1557-AF41)
entry.summary: Three tokenized Treasury products under three regimes receive comparable collateral treatment on Binance through Ceffu, with no disclosure of which instrument backs a given trade. Filed April 10, 2026 on OCC-2025-0372-0057; 3 recommendations; final rule pending.
